description: This script configures VLANs, bridges, and network interfaces for XB6 devices, managing LAN bridges, VLAN IDs, WiFi interfaces, backhaul setup, and network events.

methods.name: map_ath_to_qtn
methods.description: Maps athX interface name to Quantenna internal index, VLAN, and VAP name.

methods.name: wait_qtn
methods.description: Waits until the specified wifi interface is available.

methods.name: check_qtn_ready
methods.description: Checks if the Quantenna driver is ready, with retries and timeout.

methods.name: qtn_set_LnF_ssid
methods.description: Sets default SSID for Lost & Found WiFi.

methods.name: qtn_set_LnF_passphrase
methods.description: Sets passphrase for Lost & Found WiFi.

methods.name: qtn_configure_LnF_radius
methods.description: Configures RADIUS settings for Lost & Found WiFi.

methods.name: qtn_set_mesh
methods.description: Configures mesh network SSID and settings.

methods.name: qtn_configure_XHS
methods.description: Configures XHS SSID and passphrase.

methods.name: qtn_configure_xfinitywifi
methods.description: Configures xfinitywifi SSID and passphrase.

methods.name: setup_qtn_local
methods.description: Sets up or removes a VLAN interface for a wifi interface.

methods.name: setup_qtn
methods.description: Sets up or removes a Quantenna virtual access point (VAP).

methods.name: qtn_init
methods.description: Initializes Quantenna interfaces and VLANs at boot.

methods.name: qtn_setup_all
methods.description: Sets up all wifi access points.

methods.name: wait_for_gre_ready
methods.description: Waits until GRE tunnel is ready.

methods.name: setup_gretap
methods.description: Sets up or removes GRE tunnels.

methods.name: update_instances
methods.description: Updates the list of active multinet instances.

methods.name: get_current_if_list
methods.description: Retrieves current interfaces in a group.

methods.name: check_port_2
methods.description: Checks if switch port 2 should be enabled via dmcli.

methods.name: check_xfinity_wifi
methods.description: Checks if Xfinity WiFi is enabled.

methods.name: setup_pod_ethbhaul
methods.description: Sets up ethernet backhaul VLANs.

methods.name: remove_pod_ethbhaul
methods.description: Removes ethernet backhaul VLANs.

methods.name: get_expected_if_list
methods.description: Determines interfaces to include in a group based on mode and configuration.

methods.name: remove_from_group
methods.description: Removes an interface from a VLAN group.

methods.name: remove_from_all_groups
methods.description: Removes an interface from all VLAN groups.

methods.name: add_to_group
methods.description: Adds an interface to a VLAN group, creating VLAN interfaces if needed.

methods.name: sync_group_settings
methods.description: Creates or updates VLAN groups, adds/removes interfaces, and manages network state.

methods.name: remove_all_from_group
methods.description: Removes all interfaces from the VLAN group.

methods.name: print_syntax
methods.description: Prints usage syntax for the script.
